_comment: Voice addons the CLIENT can use: TTS (speak text) and STT (transcribe audio).
Managed live from Settings > Addons (POST /api/addons); you can also edit this
file directly - it is re-read on every save and at startup.
NOTHING IS ENABLED BY DEFAULT. Local providers are free and private (audio never
leaves this machine); the OpenAI providers need an API key and send audio to OpenAI.
TTS language: detect_language=true auto-detects en/de/ro from the text itself
(Romanian diacritics, German umlauts/ss) and then speaks with THAT language's
voice from 'voices'. Texts without diacritics fall back to fallback_lang - pass
lang explicitly to the speech endpoint to force a language.
